workItem: Consolidate CAPITAL-AI-SEC as a cross-cutting Security requirements, findings, testing and verification domain; correlate all open Security handoffs to the canonical PVC Primary Owners without absorbing foreign implementation ownership; preserve existing Security/Governance authorities and fail-closed boundaries.
workItemDE: CAPITAL-AI-SEC als querschnittliche Security-Anforderungs-, Findings-, Test- und Verification-Domain konsolidieren; alle offenen Security-Handoffs gegen die kanonischen PVC-Primary-Owner korrelieren, ohne fremde Implementierungsverantwortung zu uebernehmen; bestehende Security-/Governance-Authorities und Fail-Closed-Grenzen erhalten.
ownerRole: Cross-cutting Security; primary PVC ownership none
foreignWork: CAPITAL-AI-OPS: S1-R2-03/04/05/06/07/09/10 productive remediation or runtime evidence as routed by PVC-02/04/06/08
CAPITAL-AI-DATA: S1-R2-11 Evidence Management remediation/evidence at PVC-10
CAPITAL-AI-GOV: MFA/AAL authority-lifecycle clarification at PVC-05
CAPITAL-AI-CLIENT/CAPITAL-AI-FINTECH: child remediation only if target-owned code is identified by the entitlement inventory
authorityGuard: No new ADR/ESS/AUTH/CTRL identity is created. CAPITAL-AI-SEC owns requirements/findings/testing/verification only, no productive PVC stage. Foreign implementation remains target-project work; no self-accepted risk, autonomous production mutation, duplicate Governance Control Plane, EventMesh, data or scoring architecture.
releaseCondition: Release on merge, close, supersession or abandonment. Merge remains Human/CODEOWNER-only.
